mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a workplace injury attorney in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a workplace injury attorney in San Diego, look for someone with specific experience in California workers' compensation law. Ensure they have a proven track record of successfully handling cases similar to yours. Consider their communication style and whether you feel comfortable with them. It's also important to choose an attorney who focuses solely on representing injured workers, rather than insurance companies, to ensure their loyalty lies with you.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for an attorney in San Diego with specific experience in California workers' compensation, a strong track record, and a focus on representing injured workers.
